name: Saint Lucia

flag.description: A cerulean blue field with a central emblem of a gold triangle set in front of a larger black triangle edged in white.
flag.symbolism: Blue represents the sky and the surrounding sea, gold the sunshine, and black and white the harmony of the island's peoples; the triangles evoke the twin Pitons volcanic peaks.

hook: Saint Lucia shows its twin Pitons as a gold triangle in front of a white-edged black one on plain sky blue.
trivia: The flag was designed by Saint Lucian artist Dunstan St Omer.
Saint Lucia has produced two Nobel laureates: economist Sir Arthur Lewis (1979) and poet Derek Walcott (1992).
The island is named after Saint Lucy of Syracuse, and its national day, 13 December, is her feast day.
